start.title: [TODO:tr] Be Watchful
start.text:
[TODO:tr] Jesus says softly,
"The kingdom is like ten waiting for a bridegroom."

ignore_consequence.title: [TODO:tr] Stay Awake
ignore_consequence.text:
[TODO:tr] What he teaches now will guard your heart later.
Listen well.

wait.title: [TODO:tr] Ten at the Gate
wait.text:
[TODO:tr] Ten bridesmaids stand in the dusk,
lamps in hand, eyes on the road.

wander_consequence.title: [TODO:tr] Hold Your Place
wander_consequence.text:
[TODO:tr] Those who wait well are the ones ready.
Stay with the lamps.

oil.title: [TODO:tr] Extra Oil
oil.text:
[TODO:tr] Some carry a small flask of extra oil.
Others carry only a lamp.

choices.text: [TODO:tr] Fill a flask with extra oil

skip_consequence.title: [TODO:tr] Be Prepared
skip_consequence.text:
[TODO:tr] A wise heart plans for the long wait.
Fill the flask now.

choices.text: [TODO:tr] Fill a flask with extra oil

borrow_consequence.title: [TODO:tr] Your Own Flame
borrow_consequence.text:
[TODO:tr] Faith cannot be borrowed in the dark.
Carry your own oil.

choices.text: [TODO:tr] Fill a flask with extra oil

delay.title: [TODO:tr] The Long Wait
delay.text:
[TODO:tr] Stars wheel overhead, the bridegroom delays.
Lamps flicker low.

curse_consequence.title: [TODO:tr] His Timing
curse_consequence.text:
[TODO:tr] He comes in his own hour, not ours.
Keep the watch.

midnight.title: [TODO:tr] Midnight Cry
midnight.text:
[TODO:tr] A voice rings out at the dark hour,
"The bridegroom! Come out to meet him!"

sleep_consequence.title: [TODO:tr] Rise Now
sleep_consequence.text:
[TODO:tr] The call has come. Do not miss it.
Lift your lamp.

run.title: [TODO:tr] No Oil Left
run.text:
[TODO:tr] Five lamps sputter and die in the dark.
They run to find oil in time.

choices.text: [TODO:tr] Walk on with the wise five

mock_consequence.title: [TODO:tr] Be Humble
mock_consequence.text:
[TODO:tr] Their loss is no joy to anyone.
Walk on with care.

choices.text: [TODO:tr] Walk on with the wise five

door.title: [TODO:tr] The Door Shuts
door.text:
[TODO:tr] The bridegroom enters the feast.
The door swings closed behind him.

choices.text: [TODO:tr] Stand in the warm light within

demand_consequence.title: [TODO:tr] Be Ready First
demand_consequence.text:
[TODO:tr] The hour to prepare was before.
Readiness opens the door.

choices.text: [TODO:tr] Stand in the warm light within
choices.feedback: [TODO:tr] You enter at the right time.

ending.title: [TODO:tr] Keep Watch
ending.text:
[TODO:tr] Jesus turns to you in the soft dawn.
"Watch, for you know not the hour."
